translations.web: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
translations.bsb: Do not discard me in my old age; do not forsake me when my strength fails.
translations.kjv: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.
translations.asv: Cast me not off in the time of old age; Forsake me not when my strength faileth.
